_comment: Sevii spot overrides (notable-spots spec, authored overrides). add: {map, x, y, facing (DIR_*), kind: bench | center_side}. drop: {map, kind} drops a whole detected place; {map, x, y[, kind]} drops one spot. ignore_objects: {map, local_id} objects the walker graph treats as passable (story blockers the simulation outlives).
